text:
li: Morning — quick async update. Yesterday: landed microkernel rax allocation fix (PR #345). Bench on 2k seq showed ~7% p50 improvement but weird p95 tail. Pushed a canary image to pool-3. Need one reviewer and a sanity check on batching heuristics.

michael: Nice. Can you paste the bench numbers and the exact command you ran?

li: Sure. p50 12.3ms -> 11.5ms, p95 89ms -> 104ms (regressed). Command I used:
```
./bench --model tiny --seq 2048 --concurrency 8 --iters 100
```
Also noticed higher KV miss rate in traces around batch boundaries.

ana: (typo) ana: I'll take a look at the PR today. If p95 reg holds we should gate rollout. :eyes:

jamal: Re KV misses — replayed canary trace and saw evictions spike at burst boundaries. Quick paste from the trace:
```
evict_rate: 3.2/s -> 7.1/s at 2026-03-17T20:12
hot_keys_top10: ["chat:session:*", "embed:recent:*"]
```
Prefetch window might be too small for this workload.

li: Good catch. I'll try increasing prefetch window to 1.5x and re-run the microbench.

infra-bot: CI: build failed on linux-aarch64 (test_kv_eviction) — timeout after 300s. See: https://ci.internal/3950123456/build/78

ana: ana: queued a rerun. pinging @sre-ops for the flaky aarch job.

sre-ops: Restarted the job, checking node logs. Seeing an intermittent network hiccup in the canary region around the same timeframe.

michael: For batching heuristics, can we run a quick A/B: baseline vs -10% batch timeout? Who owns rollout config for pool-3?

li: I can add an AB toggle in the rollout config. Plan: bump prefetch, run microbench, then 50/50 AB for 30m on pool-3 and collect p50/p95 and kv miss metrics.

jamal: I'll add a regression test that replays sessions hitting the hot keys. That should catch evictions.

ana: Reviewing PR #345 now. ETA ~2h.

li: Blockers: need PR approval and a clean canary (ignoring the aarch flake). Waiting on ana + a successful canary run.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment to pool-3 scheduled (image: rkernel:v2-345). Status: pending -> will post status.

li: If p95 still degrades after prefetch bump, next step is to adjust kernel slot allocation and re-evaluate batching slot steal thresholds. Adding TODO to the issue.

michael: Sounds good. If no objections, aim to merge by EOD after ana's review and a clean 30m AB.

li: Thanks all — I'll post microbench results when the run finishes. :thumbsup:
